lead.h: The assistant has started calling you by name, and you never told it
p: Several users report that their desktop assistant used their name in conversation, though they had never typed it in. The maker says the name "may have come from the people around you".
Which people, the maker did not say. Someone wrote in the comments: it is not in the screen, it is in the room. Two hours later the comment could not be seen.
